summary: The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate programs, citing legal authority and guidance levels as evidence. It does not support any of the requested actions related to E-Rate funding or operations. The comment opposes tying E-Rate funding to the safety of childhood leukemia cases, citing evidence of increasing leukemia rates and the need to prevent new residential buildings near powerlines to reduce leukemia risk.
filer_raw: Kevin Mottus | Outreach Director, CA Brain Tumor Assn
